primitives.name: StaticAdmissibility
primitives.statement: A unary predicate A:S->{0,1} partitions states into admissible and inadmissible states.
primitives.operational_definition: A function from a state set S to {0,1}.

definitions.name: AdmissibilityAutomorphism
definitions.statement: A permutation pi of S such that A(pi(s))=A(s) for every s.

definitions.name: CanonicalDerivedRelation
definitions.statement: A binary relation on S invariant under every admissibility automorphism.

claims.statement: Every permutation preserving unary admissibility is an automorphism of the static admissibility system.
Unary static admissibility alone cannot canonically orient a nontrivial directed reachability relation between symmetric admissible states.
A weaker-than-explicit-relation structured admissibility primitive may exist that supports compositional directed dynamics without semantic smuggling.

observables.name: AutomorphismOrbit
observables.definition: Orbit of a state under all permutations preserving unary admissibility.

falsifiers.condition: Give a canonical construction from a unary admissibility predicate alone that produces an asymmetric directed relation between states in the same admissibility automorphism orbit.

metadata.purpose: Test the proposed compression of Distinction/Relation/Transformation into Constraint.
